title: Tagging standard: shared CDK Aspect applies anthus:app, anthus:account, anthus:deployment, and CI fails untagged resources
description: docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md, 'The tagging standard'. A helper every app imports (CDK Aspect; equivalents for raw CloudFormation and Amplify Gen 2) tags every resource in a stack from the stack's configuration. anthus:account is the Account UUID or 'shared'. Each app's CI fails a synthesized stack with a taggable resource missing anthus:app or anthus:account. Specs first.
